# Torah For The Table

> A weekly collection of ready-to-print Divrei Torah for the Shabbos and Yom Tov table, curated for children, families, and deeper Torah learning. New collections are published every Thursday.

Torah For The Table gathers hand-picked Divrei Torah publications for each week's parsha as downloadable PDFs. The publications are printable and organized by parsha and Jewish year.

## Pages

- [This Week's Collection](/): The current parsha's Divrei Torah, filterable by audience (Children, Families, Deeper Learning).
- [Brief Insights](/brief-insights): Bite-sized one-minute Torah insights ("vorts") on the parsha of the week, for saying over at the Shabbos table.
- [Our Originals](/originals): Torah For The Table original weekly series, including Parsha Challenge, Stories for the Shabbos Table, and In the Margins.
- [Archive](/archive): Past weekly collections, browsable by Jewish year and parsha.
- [About](/about): What Torah For The Table is and who it serves.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach us or submit a publication.
